description: Escape and unescape strings for JSON, JS, HTML, URL and regex. Operations: "escape" — Escape a string for the chosen context.; "unescape" — Unescape a string from the chosen context.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: escape: the text to escape unescape: the text to unescape

operation.description: escape — Escape a string for the chosen context. unescape — Unescape a string from the chosen context.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

mode.description: Escape mode. Used by: escape, unescape. Required by: escape, unescape.

name: string-escape
title: String Escape & Unescape
